parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The hostname or IP Address of the Controller's CoAP server.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number used by the Controller's CoAP Server to receive USP messages.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path that is used by the Controller's CoAP Server in order to receive USP messages.

parameters.name: EnableEncryption
parameters.description: When {{true}}, encryption MUST be used as specified in {{bibref|TR-369|Section "MTP Message Encryption"}}.

object.description: If the USP Endpoint uses the CoAP Message Transfer Protocol (MTP), then this object contains CoAP specific configuration parameters. {{deprecated|2.15|because the CoAP MTP was deprecated in USP 1.2}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}
